clauses.clause: This spell costs {1} less to cast if you control a creature with flying.
clauses.evidence: [cast] (and all six discard variants): 'you: ... mana C-2 U-1', the full {2}{U} is paid, with only the opponent's flier (opp_flier) on the board. No variant has a creature with flying that I control, so the discount never applies in the trace (the tree's CostModifier is IS_SOURCE, controller YOU, reduce generic 1, if at least 1 creature I control has flying). Packs G00_1 (my flier: two mana pay it), G00_2 (two fliers: exactly {1} less, not {2}), G00_3 (only an opposing flier and my non-flier: full cost). G00_4 (the opponent's flier comes under my control: it counts, control not ownership).

[cast]: 'you:Library 5#1 moves library -> hand (by card/DRAW)' and 'you:Library 4#1 moves library -> hand (by card/DRAW)', 'you: hand 7 -> 8; library 6 -> 4': the spell leaves the hand and two cards come in, drawn by me; the spell then moves stack -> graveyard. DRAW amount 2, controller YOU in the tree.
